facts.fact: The ADD's December 2024 operational manual on open data standards says the national open data portal was launched in 2011, that the Agence de Développement du Digital coordinates the Open Data programme and is responsible for the portal, and that every dataset published there must meet its minimum quality criteria; it states that the portal hosts datasets of some administrations and references datasets on sector portals, names no ministry or agency that has released data and gives no dataset or publisher count, and ties the portal to no open data policy, strategy or law.

systems.owner: Agence de Développement du Digital (ADD), coordinator of the Open Data programme and responsible for the national portal
systems.tiers: national; structures publiques publish directly or connect their own open data portals, which are referenced on it

systems.system: Loi n°31-13 relative au droit d'accès à l'information
systems.tiers: national; access to information law on which the document says open data in Morocco currently rests

systems.country_label: étude sur la préparation du Maroc à l'ouverture des données publiques
systems.tiers: national; a 2019-2020 study including an analysis of the legal framework

note: No standing fact: the manual names no open data policy, strategy or law (it says open data rests on the access to information law 31-13, law 09-08 and law 05-20) and gives no draft or adoption date; 'stratégie open data' appears only as a role heading in an actors matrix.
